messages:
priya: Handoff for tonight, I'm off at 21:00 UTC. No active incidents but a couple of follow-ups from the last postmortem are still 'in flight' and worth watching: INF-312 (model routing/backoff) and INF-299 (cache invalidation timing). Leaving quick checklist below and who owns what. :wave:

priya: Current risk summary: model-routing errors ~5% on a small subset of requests after the cache TTL change. We deployed a mitigant (remediation PR #1024) to prod earlier but saw a couple of regressions during the canary. If errors spike >10% for 5m, please flip the routing fallback to the dedicated-variant (run the CLI below).

priya: Quick commands to triage:
```
# run a small canary against model-routing service
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/internal/canary -d '{"route":"model-routing"}' | jq '.'

# check last 30m errors in datadog
# use the oncall query saved as "model.routing.errors.30m"
open https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/model.routing.errors.30m

# fallback toggle (ops-cli)
ops-cli routing fallback set --route model-routing --variant dedicated-variant
```

alex: I can cover 21:00-03:00 UTC tonight. I'll check the canary on handoff and keep eyes on the KV cache hit-rate dashboard. If I see >8% errors I'll start the fallback and ping runtime. :thumbsup:

ben: Quick note — PR #1024 has a small config that needs one more review (timeout tweak). If someone can approve it early, we can avoid a manual rollback. Pinged eng-runtime in the PR comments. @alex maybe you can give it a quick glance if you have cycles.

jamie: Short onboarding checklist for whoever's on next: 1) run the canary (see commands), 2) check the kv-cache hit ratio (Datadog: KV.Cache.HitRatio), 3) confirm no high-queue times on the dedicated pool (Console -> Dedicated -> Pools). If you do the fallback remember to also update the incident slack header with the action taken.

sara: deploy-bot: Deployed remediation PR #1024 to prod at 2026-03-16T18:40:12Z (commit b3f7a2c). Canary tests passed 20/22 but two failures were 502s. See pipeline logs: https://ci.redwood/6789/logs

alex: @ben I'll take a look at #1024 now. If I can't get to it before the window ends, I'll note to rollback-ready and add repro steps to the PR.

ben: Also leaving a note about INF-299 — the cache invalidation window automation hasn't been backfilled for customers on older config. It's low-likelihood but high-severity if it collides with a config push. There's a monitoring alert on the backlog but no auto-blocker. If you see any simultaneous config-rollout + model updates, escalate to eng-platform.

priya: Thanks all. One more thing: I ran a regression check against the eval-suite and saw a perf dip on long-context sequences for quantized variants after the change. It's in INF-312 notes. If it gets worse, please tag me and eng-ml so we can triage. Otherwise, @alex you're set as primary; @jamie or @ben can step in if needed. :white_check_mark:

alex: Got it. Will follow up on PR and watch dashboards. Leaving playbook in case: https://confluence.redwood/playbooks/oncall-handoff (section "model-routing followup"). :eyes:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: nightly-checks at 23:00 UTC (canary + KV hit ratio).

priya: I'll check in tomorrow morning to confirm closure on INF-312. If you end up toggling fallback, leave a short note here with reason and metric snapshot. Thanks and have a good night! :coffee:
